Compositor Windows Preview

An independent Windows port of Compositor by Robbie Tilton. Ported behavior follows upstream 1.0.4 through 1.4.5. The dependency pin remains the 1.0.4 commit a19db90. Mac equivalence is unverified.

Original Compositor project
Copyright Wonder Assembly LLC. MIT source.

This independent port is not endorsed by the upstream author.

Qt and other dependency notices accompany this package.
